executive_summary:
This is a year of bank transactions for a bakery, from 1 November 2025 to 31 October 2026: 1,305 entries covering daily WeChat Pay, Alipay and cash takings, payments from two wholesale customers, and the bills, including payroll, ingredients, rent, utilities, tax and an equipment loan.

The headline is cash. The account holds 90,263 at the end of October. Over the last three months the business spent 344,644 a month on average against 278,550 coming in, a shortfall of 66,094 a month. At that rate the cash lasts about six weeks, and the balance is likely to fall below zero around 12 December. Getting safely through the next 90 days would take roughly 200,000.

This is a recent change. Through the winter the bakery made money every month, with its best month in February (+52,092) thanks to the Spring Festival. Since June it has lost money every month. Shop sales are the main reason: they fell from about 295,000 a month in November to January to about 233,000 in September and October, roughly a fifth lower. Payroll also rose by 8,000 a month in June.

Payroll (45%) and ingredients (35%) make up four-fifths of spending, so that is where savings would count. Shop sales bring in 86% of the money and the two wholesale customers the other 14%.

The data was complete and no values were changed. 121 unusually large transactions, mostly ingredient orders, payroll and rent, were flagged for a check and kept as they are. Three phone numbers and 18 customer and supplier names in the file were hidden from the AI.

executive_summary_zh:
这是一家烘焙店一整年的银行流水，时间从2025年11月1日到2026年10月31日，共1,305笔，包括每天的微信支付、支付宝和现金收入，两家批发客户的回款，以及工资、原料、房租、水电、税费和设备贷款等支出。

最重要的是现金。10月底账户余额为90,263元。最近三个月，平均每月支出344,644元，收入只有278,550元，每月缺口66,094元。按这个速度，现金大约只能维持六周，余额很可能在12月12日前后跌破零。要安全度过未来90天，大约需要准备200,000元。

这是最近才出现的变化。整个冬天店铺每个月都盈利，2月受春节带动表现最好（盈余52,092元）。从6月起每个月都在亏损。主要原因是门店销售下滑：从11月至1月每月约295,000元，降到9至10月每月约233,000元，减少了约五分之一。同时，6月起工资每月增加了8,000元。

工资（45%）和原料（35%）占全部支出的五分之四，是节省成本的关键。门店销售贡献了86%的收入，两家批发客户贡献其余14%。

数据完整，没有修改任何数值。121笔金额异常大的交易（主要是原料采购、工资和房租）已标记供核查，原样保留。文件中的3个电话号码以及18个客户和供应商名称已对AI隐藏。
